errors.source_span: there were many widows in __PEOPLE_A__ in __PROPHET_A__ time
errors.translation_span: 那时在 __PEOPLE_A__ 有许多寡妇
errors.explanation: The phrasing in the translation places the time clause ('__PROPHET_A__ 的时候') before the mention of widows rather than explicitly linking 'many widows in __PEOPLE_A__ in __PROPHET_A__ time' as a single unit, which slightly affects clarity and temporal connection.

errors.source_span: to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon
errors.translation_span: 去西顿地区撒勒法的一位寡妇那里
errors.explanation: The preposition 'to' indicating the prophet being sent 'to' the widow is implied but less explicit in Chinese; this may reduce precision slightly.

errors.source_span: a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit
errors.translation_span: 一个人被污鬼附着
errors.explanation: The source uses 'demon' and 'impure spirit', which have distinct connotations; the translation uses only '污鬼' (unclean spirit), merging the two terms.

errors.source_span: You are the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__!
errors.translation_span: 你是 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的儿子！
errors.explanation: The source uses the definite article 'the Son of the Most High,' indicating a unique title, whereas the translation omits 'the' which slightly reduces the emphasis on uniqueness.

errors.source_span: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说,“上面写着,‘人不能单靠面包生存
errors.explanation: The translation completely omits that Jesus was full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness; instead, it starts with Jesus answering a quote from the Bible, which belongs to verse 4.

errors.source_span: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
errors.translation_span: 撒下9 魔鬼对他说、你若是神的儿子、就叫这石头作面包
errors.explanation: Typographical or formatting error: '撒下9' inserted incorrectly, disrupting fluency and clarity.

errors.source_span: And he said to him, “I will give you all their authority and splendor; it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.
errors.translation_span: 撒上9 耶稣对他说、我必赐给你他们的一切权柄和光荣. 这是赐给我的、我可以赐给谁也愿意。
errors.explanation: Typographical or formatting error: '撒上9' inserted incorrectly and Jesus is mistakenly the subject speaking (it should be the devil). Also punctuation issues reduce fluency.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.’
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说、有记载说、你们要奉耶和华你们的 神、只奉他。
errors.explanation: The translation changes 'Worship the Lord your God and serve him only' into '你们要奉耶和华你们的神，只奉他' which is somewhat unclear and differs in wording; '奉' (serve/give) is less precise for 'worship' and the structure is awkward, reducing accuracy.

errors.source_span: The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.
errors.translation_span: 魔鬼带他到耶路撒冷,叫他站在庙顶上。
errors.explanation: '庙顶上' is an ambiguous translation for 'the highest point of the temple'; a more precise term like '圣殿的最高处' would be better.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说、有人说、不可试用耶和华你的 神。
errors.explanation: The phrase '不可试用耶和华你的神' is awkward and incorrect; '试用' is inappropriate for 'test' here, better translation is '不可试探耶和华你的神'.

errors.source_span: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.
errors.translation_span: 撒下9:7 魔鬼把这一切诱惑都作完、就离开他、直到有的时候
errors.explanation: Typographical or formatting error: '撒下9:7' incorrect insertion, breaks fluency and confuses meaning. Also '直到有的时候' is vague; better is '直到适当的时候'.

errors.source_span: He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom.
errors.translation_span: 他到了 Nazareth,在那里长大。 安息日,他按自己的习俗进入犹太会堂,站起来看书,
errors.explanation: Use of 'Nazareth' untranslated inconsistent with other proper nouns; it should be translated to '拿撒勒' for standardization. Also '看书' is less precise than '读' or '朗读' for reading scripture.

errors.source_span: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor...
errors.translation_span: 耶和华的灵在我身上,因他使我为穷人传福音、为囚犯宣扬自由、为瞎子恢复视力、使受压迫的人自由、
errors.explanation: The translation omits '膏立我' (anointed me) which is significant terminology related to the Messianic role.

errors.source_span: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
errors.translation_span: 宣布耶和华的恩赐年。
errors.explanation: The translation uses '恩赐年' (year of gifts) which is a mistranslation for '年 of the Lord’s favor' which should be '耶和华恩典的年' or '主悦纳的年'.

errors.source_span: The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him.
errors.translation_span: synagogue里所有的人都盯着他。
errors.explanation: Use of untranslated English word 'synagogue' inconsistent with prior '犹太会堂' and reduces cohesion.

errors.source_span: “Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
errors.translation_span: 创8 耶稣说、今日这经在你们的听中成就了。
errors.explanation: Unexplained insertion of '创8' disrupts flow and is likely an error or misplaced reference.

errors.source_span: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips.
errors.translation_span: 他们都对他讲得很好,惊奇地听见他从嘴里说的话。
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation "他们都对他讲得很好" is awkward and alters the meaning; it should express that all spoke well of him, not that they spoke well to him.

errors.source_span: Capernaum
errors.translation_span: Capernaum
errors.explanation: Capernaum is left untranslated in the Chinese text; an established Chinese equivalent is usually used for place names.

errors.source_span: Zarephath in the region of Sidon
errors.translation_span: 西顿的 Zarephath
errors.explanation: Place name 'Zarephath' is only partially translated; typically both '西顿' and '撒勒法' (Zarephath) would be fully translated in Chinese.

errors.source_span: with leprosy
errors.translation_span: 患了瘟疫
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation "患了瘟疫" means "suffered from plague," which incorrectly translates 'leprosy' (麻风病) and changes the disease described.

errors.source_span: the Holy One of God
errors.translation_span: 神圣的
errors.explanation: The phrase 'the Holy One of God' is translated as '神圣的', which does not fully convey the theological significance; the standard Chinese Bible uses '神的圣者' or similar.

errors.source_span: She got up at once and began to wait on them.
errors.translation_span: 她立刻起来,等着他们。
errors.explanation: The phrase '等着他们' suggests 'waiting for them' rather than 'waiting on them' (serving them), which is a different meaning.

errors.source_span: laying his hands on each one, he healed them
errors.translation_span: 耶稣把手放在每个人身上,医治他们
errors.explanation: The translation conveys the meaning accurately, no significant omission.

errors.source_span: But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.
errors.translation_span: 太5:9 又有许多恶魔从百姓中出来、喊道、你是神的儿子。
errors.explanation: The translation omits that Jesus rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak. Instead, it introduces an unrelated citation (太5:9).

errors.source_span: a solitary place
errors.translation_span: 一个孤儿的地方
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly renders 'solitary place' as '孤儿的地方' ('orphan's place'), which changes the meaning completely.

errors.source_span: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
errors.translation_span: 他在犹太的犹太会堂继续传教。
errors.explanation: Translation repeats '犹太' redundantly ('犹太的犹太会堂'); however, the meaning is still recoverable.

errors.source_span: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:"经上说:'人不靠饼活下去. '"
errors.explanation: The translation omits the entire statement about Jesus being full of the Holy Spirit, leaving the Jordan, and being led into the wilderness. Instead, it starts with Jesus' answer to the devil's temptation, which is from verse 4, skipping the initial context.

errors.source_span: where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.
errors.translation_span: 在那里四十天,被魔鬼试探.在那四天里,他什么也没有吃,在那四天结束的时候,他就饿了.
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly says '在那四天里'(in those four days) instead of 'forty days'. The number 'forty' is mistranslated as 'four', which is a significant omission affecting meaning.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:"经上说:'人不靠饼活下去. '"
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'alone' (alone means '仅靠') after bread, changing the biblical nuance. However, this is a minor omission since the core meaning is mostly conveyed.

errors.source_span: For it is written: 'He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;
errors.translation_span: 因为经上说: 神必吩咐他的使者保护你.
errors.explanation: The translation omits the full quotation about angels lifting him up in their hands so he will not strike his foot against a stone. This truncation removes important context and weakens the quote's meaning.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:"又说:'不可试探主你的神.'
errors.explanation: Missing the quotation marks at the end and the full structure but the meaning is preserved. Minor fluency issue.

errors.source_span: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.
errors.translation_span: 魔鬼已经试探了耶稣,就离开他,等到另一个时机.
errors.explanation: Minor change in wording ('另一个时机' vs. '合适的时机'), but meaning is preserved and acceptable.

errors.source_span: Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him.
errors.translation_span: 门徒把书卷卷起来,还给侍奉的人,就坐下了.在会堂里的人都着着他.
errors.explanation: Translation incorrectly says '门徒' (disciples) instead of the correct attendant or helper who returns the scroll. This incorrectly adds a subject not in the source, causing an addition error. Also, '着着他' is a typo or mistranslation likely meant to be '注视着他' (watched him attentively).

errors.source_span: He began by saying to them, “Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
errors.translation_span: 他就对他们说: 今天,你们听这经文已经成就了.
errors.explanation: The translation conveys the meaning but uses a slightly awkward phrasing ('你们听这经文已经成就了' literally 'you have heard this scripture fulfilled'), which is understandable but less idiomatic. Minor fluency issue.

errors.source_span: and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips
errors.translation_span: 惊奇他的口中出来的慈爱的话
errors.explanation: The phrase '口中出来的慈爱的话' is slightly awkward and not a natural Chinese expression, reducing fluency.

errors.source_span: when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land
errors.translation_span: 天闭了三年六月,遍地大饥荒
errors.explanation: The translation '三年六月' literally reads 'three years and six months' but does not clearly express 'three and a half years'; this phrasing is ambiguous and may confuse readers.

errors.source_span: with leprosy
errors.translation_span: 有许多长
errors.explanation: The word 'leprosy' is mistranslated as '许多长' (many longs?), which is unclear and omits the disease's meaning.

errors.source_span: they got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff
errors.translation_span: 他们起来,把耶稣赶到城外,带他到城所建立的山顶上,要把他从山顶上推下去
errors.explanation: The source emphasizes the hill on which the town was built (the brow of the hill), but '城所建立的山顶' could be misleading, implying a mountain top rather than a hill brow; the nuance is lost.

errors.source_span: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way
errors.translation_span: 他穿过群众,就走了.耶稣把那不洁的灵赶出去
errors.explanation: The phrase '耶稣把那不洁的灵赶出去' (Jesus drove out the impure spirit) is not in the source verse 30 but inserted here, representing an addition error.

errors.source_span: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee
errors.translation_span: 耶稣下到加利利的一个城,叫迦百内
errors.explanation: The place name '迦百内' is incorrect; the source is 'Capernaum,' usually translated as '迦百农' or '迦百农城' in Chinese Bibles, so this is a mistranslation of the place name.

errors.source_span: Jesus of Nazareth
errors.translation_span: 拿撒勒人耶稣啊
errors.explanation: Adding '啊' after '拿撒勒人耶稣' is an acceptable interrogative particle in spoken Chinese but may be considered an unnecessary addition in formal translation.

errors.source_span: “Be quiet!” Jesus said sternly
errors.translation_span: 耶稣责备他说: "!从他里面出来!"
errors.explanation: Translation is missing the words for 'Be quiet' or equivalent; the exclamation mark '!' in front of '从他里面出来' is a likely typographical error/misplacement affecting readability.

errors.source_span: Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever
errors.translation_span: 西门的,已经患了大发烧
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'mother-in-law' for Simon; just '西门的' (of Simon) is incomplete and inaccurate, omitting an important relationship.

errors.source_span: She got up at once and began to wait on them
errors.translation_span: 她立刻起来,就服事他们
errors.explanation: '服事' is acceptable but slightly formal or archaic compared to common expressions like '伺候他们'; not a strict error, just a note on stylistic choice.

errors.source_span: demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!"
errors.translation_span: 许多人的灵魂也出来,大声说:"你是神的儿子!"
errors.explanation: The translation renders 'demons' as '灵魂' (souls), which changes the meaning. The source clearly refers to demons, not souls.

errors.source_span: I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.
errors.translation_span: 我必須傳神的國的福音到別的城裡,因為我是為這事被差來的
errors.explanation: The phrase '神的國的福音' is somewhat awkward in Chinese; a more fluent phrasing would be '神國的福音' or '天國的福音'. However, this is a minor fluency issue and does not affect meaning significantly.

errors.source_span: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:经上写着说:人不只靠面包活.
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly places Jesus' answer from verse 4 as verse 1, omitting the fact that Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’"
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:经上写着说:人不只靠面包活.
errors.explanation: The translation repeats the answer from verse 4 earlier at verse 1 and omits other content from verses 1-4.

errors.source_span: ‘He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully; they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’
errors.translation_span: 因为有经上说:"他要吩咐他的使者,照顾你. 他们必举你手上,免得你的脚撞到石头.
errors.explanation: The translation slightly simplifies the source, changing 'guard you carefully' to '照顾你' (care for you), which is less precise but generally acceptable.

errors.source_span: Jesus answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣回答说:有说:' 不要试探耶和华 ─ 你的神. '
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'It is said' to a simpler '有说', which is acceptable as an equivalent expression.

errors.source_span: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.
errors.translation_span: 魔鬼试探了一切,就离开他,直到另一个机会.
errors.explanation: The translation '直到另一个机会' is a valid paraphrase of 'until an opportune time.'

errors.source_span: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.
errors.translation_span: 宣告主的恩赐之年.
errors.explanation: The phrase '主的恩赐之年' ('year of the Lord's favor') is translated as '主的恩赐之年,' which is an omission of the meaning of 'favor' (favor/acceptance), making the meaning incomplete.

errors.translation_span: 以色列中有许多病人,但没有一个,惟有叙利亚人拿曼才得了治愈
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly translates 'leprosy' as '病人' (patients/sick people) instead of specifically '麻风病' (leprosy), which misses the specific disease context.

errors.source_span: Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever
errors.translation_span: 西门的因烧得很大
errors.explanation: The translation mistranslates 'mother-in-law' as '因烧' which is incorrect and meaningless; the correct term should be '婆婆' or similar to specify 'mother-in-law'.

errors.source_span: At sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness
errors.translation_span: 到了日落的时候,众人带着各种病患的,都带来耶稣那里去
errors.explanation: The Chinese phrasing is slightly awkward and redundant ('带着各种病患的,都带来耶稣那里去'). It would be smoother without duplication of '带着' and '都带来'.

errors.source_span: laying his hands on each one, he healed them
errors.translation_span: 他就按手给他们各人,治愈他们
errors.explanation: The phrase '给他们各人' is less natural; better phrasing would be '一一按手' or '按手在他们各人身上' for clarity and naturalness.

errors.source_span: demons came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!”
errors.translation_span: 许多人中,鬼都出来,喊着说:你是神的儿子
errors.explanation: The source indicates 'demons came out of many people,' but the translation says '许多人中,鬼都出来' which could be literally interpreted as 'all demons in many people came out,' slightly ambiguous and less precise on the source's nuance that demons came out from many people individually.

errors.source_span: because they knew he was the Messiah
errors.translation_span: 因为他们知道他是基督
errors.explanation: The translation uses '基督' for 'Messiah,' which is acceptable, but without additional context might confuse readers unfamiliar with the term; however, this is generally acceptable.

errors.source_span: Jesus went out to a solitary place
errors.translation_span: 耶稣出去去一个孤独的地方
errors.explanation: The phrase '出去去' is redundant in Chinese; just '出去' or '去' suffices.

errors.source_span: The people were looking for him
errors.translation_span: 众人寻找他
errors.explanation: The source implies a continuous action ('were looking for him'), which is adequately captured by the translation.

errors.source_span: when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them
errors.translation_span: 到了他那里,就不叫他离开他们
errors.explanation: The source indicates an active attempt to prevent Jesus from leaving, 'they tried to keep him from leaving them,' but the translation's '就不叫他离开他们' is awkward and less explicit about the effort made; it literally says 'would not let him leave,' which is acceptable but less natural and could be clearer.

errors.source_span: I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent
errors.translation_span: 我也必须传福音,传神的国,因为我就是奉命去传福音
errors.explanation: The translation omits the specificity of 'other towns' (to neighboring towns), and repeats '传福音' twice, losing the nuance that the reason for going to other places is the mission. The phrase '因为我就是奉命去传福音' is a distorted expression and not faithful to the source meaning.

errors.source_span: he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea
errors.translation_span: 他在犹大各处的犹太教堂里传道
errors.explanation: The translation generally captures the meaning, but '犹太教堂' is a literal but uncommon term for 'synagogues;' '会堂' is more standard in Chinese Bible translations.

errors.source_span: One day as __PERSON_F__ was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of __MOST_HIGH_A__.
errors.translation_span: missing
errors.explanation: The translation completely omits the verse 1 content; it starts abruptly with Simon's reply rather than the scene setting about __PERSON_F__ standing by the lake and people listening.

errors.source_span: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
errors.translation_span: 他 锯 在 这 水的 边缘 二 船, 左边 那里 经过 这 渔民, WHO 是 洗涤 他们的 网。
errors.explanation: The translation has poor grammar and incorrect word order; '锯' (saw) is misplaced, and 'WHO 是 洗涤' is a direct, nonsensical translation of 'who were washing'. Not a fluent or correct rendering.

errors.source_span: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
errors.translation_span: 他 得到 进入 一 的 这 船, 这 一 归属感 到 西蒙, 和 问 他 到 放 出去 一个 小的 从 支撑。 然后 他 坐 向下 和 教过的 这 人们 从 这 船。
errors.explanation: The translation is very literal and awkward, with incorrect phrases like '得到 进入' (obtained enter), '归属感 到 西蒙' (belonging feeling to Simon), and '问 他 到 放 出去 一个 小的 从 支撑' (asked him to put out a little from support). These do not convey the original meaning properly.

errors.source_span: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”
errors.translation_span: 什么时候 他 有 完成的 请讲， 他 说 到 西蒙, “放 出去 进入 深的 水， 和 让 向下 这 网 为了 一个 抓住。”
errors.explanation: The translation uses incorrect grammar and word order; '什么时候 他 有 完成的 请讲' is a poor rendering of 'When he had finished speaking'; also, '让 向下 这 网 为了 一个 抓住' is awkward for 'let down the nets for a catch'.

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 西蒙 回答说， “掌握， 我们已经 工作过 难的 全部 夜晚 和 没有 捕捉 任何事物。 但 因为 你 说 所以， 我 将要 让 向下 这 网。”
errors.explanation: The translation contains unnatural phrases: '掌握' for 'Master' is a mistranslation (correct is '主人' or '夫子'); '工作过 难的 全部 夜晚' is awkward and unnatural for 'worked hard all night'; '捕捉 任何事物' is unnatural for 'caught anything'; overall message is distorted.

errors.source_span: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
errors.translation_span: 什么时候 他们 有 完毕 所以， 他们 捕捉 这样的 一个 大的 数字 的 鱼 那 他们的 网 开始 到 休息。
errors.explanation: Translation has poor grammar and word usage: '捕捉' is inappropriate for fishing (normally '捕捞'), '开始 到 休息' is nonsensical; overall, the sentence is confusing and inaccurate.

errors.source_span: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
errors.translation_span: 所以 他们 发出信号 他们的 合作伙伴 在 这 其他 船 到 来 和 帮助 他们， 和 他们 来了 和 充满 两个都 船 所以 满的 那 他们 开始 到 下沉。
errors.explanation: Translation is very literal with unnatural word order and phrasing: '发出信号 他们的 合作伙伴 在 这 其他 船 到 来' is clumsy; '充满 两个都 船 所以 满的' is unnatural Chinese; '开始 到 下沉' is an inaccurate phrase.

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at __PERSON_F__ knees and said, “Go away from me, __MASTER_A__; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 什么时候 西蒙 彼得 锯 这， 他 跌倒了 在 __PERSON_F__ 膝盖 和 说， “去 离开 从 我， __MASTER_A__; 我 是 一个 有罪的 男人！”
errors.explanation: '锯' is a wrong character for 'saw' (should be '看到'); the phrase '去 离开 从 我' is a redundant and unnatural way to say 'go away from me'; the rest is roughly understandable but awkward.

errors.source_span: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.
errors.translation_span: 所以 他们 拉 他们的 船 向上 在 支撑， 左边 一切 和 已关注 他。
errors.explanation: '向上 在 支撑' is awkward and unclear for 'up on shore'; '左边 一切' is an incorrect translation of 'left everything'; '已关注 他' is incorrect for 'followed him' (should be '跟随他' or '跟着他').

errors.source_span: While __PERSON_F__ was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy.[b] When he saw __PERSON_F__, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, “__MASTER_A__, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”
errors.translation_span: 尽管 __PERSON_F__ 曾是 在 一 的 这 城镇, 一个 男人 来了 沿着 WHO 曾是 覆盖 和 麻风病。[b] 什么时候 他 锯 __PERSON_F__, 他 跌倒了 和 他的 脸 到 这 地面 和 恳求 他， “__MASTER_A__, 如果 你 是 愿意的， 你 能 制作 我 干净的。”
errors.explanation: '尽管' (although) is incorrect for 'while'; '来了 沿着 WHO 曾是' is a literal and incorrect phrase; '锯' again misused; '你 能 制作 我 干净的' is unnatural, 'make me clean' should be '使我洁净'.

errors.source_span: was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there
errors.translation_span: 曾是 教学， 和 法利赛人 和 教师 的 这 法律 是 坐着 那里
errors.explanation: The translation is a literal word-by-word translation with incorrect grammar and word order, making it hard to understand; it fails to properly convey 'was teaching' and that Pharisees and teachers were 'sitting there.'

errors.source_span: had come from every village of __REGION_A__ and from Judea and __CITY_A__
errors.translation_span: 他们 有 来 从 每一个 村庄 的 __REGION_A__ 和 从 朱迪亚 和 __CITY_A__
errors.explanation: Word order and grammar are incorrect resulting in unclear meaning; the Chinese does not properly render the past action 'had come from' and the phrase sounds fragmented.

errors.source_span: And the power of the __MASTER_A__ was with __PERSON_F__ to heal the sick
errors.translation_span: 和 这 力量 的 这 __MASTER_A__ 曾是 和 __PERSON_F__ 到 愈合 这 生病的
errors.explanation: Incorrect grammar and awkward phrasing; 'was with __PERSON_F__ to heal the sick' is not correctly translated, making the meaning unclear.

errors.source_span: they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of __PERSON_F__
errors.translation_span: 他们 去了 向上 在 这 屋顶 和 降低 他 在 他的 垫 通过 这 瓷砖 进入 这 中间 的 这 人群， 正确的 在 正面 的 __人_f__
errors.explanation: The translation uses literal but unnatural phrasing ('降低...通过这瓷砖'), and mistakenly renders __PERSON_F__ as __人_f__, a formatting inconsistency.

errors.source_span: Friend, your sins are forgiven
errors.translation_span: 朋友， 你的 罪恶 是 原谅了
errors.explanation: '罪恶' is an unusual choice; '罪' or '罪孽' is more standard for 'sins'. Also, '是原谅了' is an awkward phrasing; better would be '已被赦免' or '你的罪得赦免了'.

errors.source_span: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, "Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but __MOST_HIGH_A__ alone?"
errors.translation_span: 这 法利赛人 和 这 教师 的 这 法律 开始 思维 到 他们自己， “WHO 是 这 同胞 WHO 说话 亵渎？ WHO 能 原谅 罪恶 但 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 独自的？”
errors.explanation: Literal English words 'WHO' is untranslated and appears incorrectly. Grammar and word order are incorrect, making this sentence unintelligible in Chinese. The phrase '同胞' is incorrect for 'fellow' here; should be translated as '家伙' or '此人'.

errors.source_span: __PERSON_F__ knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
errors.translation_span: __PERSON_F__ 知道 什么 他们 是 思维 和 问， “为什么 是 你 思维 这些 事物 在 你的 心？
errors.explanation: Word-by-word translation with poor syntax and grammar; the sentence is ungrammatical and hard to understand.

errors.source_span: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
errors.translation_span: 哪个 是 更轻松： 到 说， '你的 罪恶 是 原谅了，” 或者 到 说， '得到 向上 和 走'?
errors.explanation: Incorrect grammar and awkward, unidiomatic phrasing (e.g., '得到 向上 和 走'). The expression does not convey the original meaning clearly.

errors.source_span: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.
errors.translation_span: 但 我 想 你 到 知道 那 这 儿子 的 男人 有 权威 在 地球 到 原谅 罪过。
errors.explanation: Word-by-word translation with improper word order and unnatural phrasing; '这 儿子 的 男人' is a wrong literal translation of 'Son of Man' and should be corrected.

errors.source_span: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising __MOST_HIGH_A__.
errors.translation_span: 立即地 他 站着 向上 在 正面 的 他们， 采取了 什么 他 有 到过 说谎 在 和 去了 家 赞美 __MOST_HIGH_A__.
errors.explanation: The phrase '采取了 什么 他 有 到过 说谎 在' is nonsensical, literally 'took what he had lied on'; 'lying' is mistranslated as '说谎'. This is a mistranslation causing confusion but the overall meaning is mostly recoverable.

errors.source_span: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to __MOST_HIGH_A__. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”
errors.translation_span: 每个人 曾是 惊讶 和 给了 称赞 到 __MOST_HIGH_A__. 他们 是 充满 和 敬畏 和 说， “我们 有 见过 卓越 事物 今天。”
errors.explanation: Unnatural phrasing and incorrect word usage such as '曾是 惊讶' (was amazed), '给了 称赞 到'. '卓越 事物' is a literal but awkward translation of 'remarkable things.'

errors.source_span: After this, __PERSON_F__ went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth.
errors.translation_span: 后 这， __PERSON_F__ 去了 出去 和 锯 一个 税 集电极 经过 这 姓名 的 列维 坐着 在 他的 税 摊位。
errors.explanation: The verb '锯' (saw) is incorrectly chosen (it means 'to saw' as in cutting with a saw) instead of the correct '看见' or '看到'.

errors.source_span: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.
errors.translation_span: 和 列维 得到 向上， 左边 一切 和 已关注 他。
errors.explanation: Awkward phrasing: '得到 向上' for 'got up', '左边 一切' for 'left everything' and '已关注 他' for 'followed him' are incorrect or unnatural translations.

errors.source_span: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”
errors.translation_span: 但 这 法利赛人 和 这 教师 的 这 法律 WHO 属于 到 他们的 教派 抱怨 到 他的 弟子们， “为什么 做 你 吃 和 喝 和 税 收藏家 和 罪人？”
errors.explanation: The untranslated English word 'WHO' appears again improperly. Also, word order and some prepositions are incorrect making the sentence unnatural.

errors.source_span: It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
errors.translation_span: “它 是 不是 这 健康 WHO 需要 一个 医生， 但 这 生病的。
errors.explanation: Contains untranslated 'WHO', awkward literal translation, and unnatural phrasing; 'It is not the healthy...' is not properly conveyed.

errors.source_span: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
errors.translation_span: 我 有 不是 来 到 称呼 这 正义， 但 罪人 到 悔改。
errors.explanation: Awkward phrasing and unnatural literal translation; '称呼 这 正义' is wrong for 'call the righteous'. The meaning is mostly recoverable but poorly expressed.

errors.source_span: __PERSON_C__ disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking
errors.translation_span: __PERSON_C__ 门徒 经常 快速地 和 祈祷， 和 所以 做 这 门徒 的 这 法利赛人, 但 你的 去 在 吃 和 喝
errors.explanation: The translation is ungrammatical and confusing in Chinese. The phrase '快速地' (fast) is misused (should be '禁食' for 'fast'); word order and connectors are inappropriate, making the meaning unclear. The comparison between disciples is incorrectly rendered, diminishing clarity.

errors.source_span: Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?
errors.translation_span: 能 你 制作 这 朋友们 的 这 新郎 快速地 尽管 他 是 和 他们？
errors.explanation: The translation is awkward and ungrammatical. '制作...快速地' is nonsensical; 'make...fast' should be translated as '使...禁食'. The sentence structure is broken and distorts the meaning.

errors.source_span: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.
errors.translation_span: 但 这 时间 将要 来 什么时候 这 新郎 将要 是 采取 从 他们; 在 那些 天 他们 将要 快速地。
errors.explanation: The phrase '将要 是 采取 从 他们' is an incorrect, literal word-by-word translation of 'will be taken from them', rendering it incomprehensible. '快速地' (quickly) is wrong for 'fast' (禁食). The overall sentence is ungrammatical.

errors.source_span: No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one. Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
errors.translation_span: 不 一 眼泪 一个 片 出去 的 一个 新的 服装 到 修补 一个 老的 一。 否则， 他们 将要 有 撕裂 这 新的 服装， 和 这 修补 从 这 新的 将要 不是 匹配 这 老的。
errors.explanation: The translation is a literal word-by-word rendering resulting in an awkward and ungrammatical sentence. For example, '不 一 眼泪' is nonsense; proper verbs and syntax are missing. It obscures the meaning of the parable.

errors.source_span: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.
errors.translation_span: 和 不 一 倒 新的 葡萄酒 进入 老的 酒袋。 否则， 这 新的 葡萄酒 将要 爆裂 这 皮肤； 这 葡萄酒 将要 跑步 出去 和 这 酒袋 将要 是 毁了。
errors.explanation: The translation suffers from word-by-word translation issues, e.g. '不 一 倒' is incorrect grammar for 'no one pours'; '跑步出去' literally means 'run out' incorrectly applied to wine running out. '皮肤' is incorrect for 'wine skins' (should be '酒袋'). The sentence is confusing.

errors.source_span: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.
errors.translation_span: 不， 新的 葡萄酒 必须 是 倒 进入 新的 酒袋。
errors.explanation: The translation is understandable but contains unnatural and slightly awkward phrasing, e.g. '必须 是 倒 进入' instead of the more natural '必须倒入'. Minor grammatical awkwardness.

errors.source_span: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’
errors.translation_span: 和 不 一 后 喝 老的 葡萄酒 想要 这 新的， 为了 他们 说， '这 老的 是 更好的。'”
errors.explanation: The translation has word-by-word literalism causing awkwardness, such as '不 一 后 喝' which is ungrammatical for 'no one after drinking'. The meaning is preserved but phrasing is unnatural.

errors.source_span: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.
errors.translation_span: 2 他在水边看到两艘船
errors.explanation: The translation omits the introduction about Jesus standing by the Lake of Gennesaret and the people crowding around him listening to the word of God; it starts directly with seeing the boats, missing the setting and the crowd listening.

errors.source_span: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
errors.translation_span: 他进入了一艘属于西蒙的船,要求他从岸边撒点水,然后他坐下来教人从船上。
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly renders 'put out a little from shore' as '撒点水' (sprinkle water). The correct meaning is to move the boat slightly away from the shore. Also, the phrase 'teach the people from the boat' is somewhat unclear in Chinese and missing the nuance of 'from the boat'.

errors.source_span: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”
errors.translation_span: 他说话完毕的时候,他对赛门说:你们把水倒在深水里,你们把鱼网放下来钓鱼吧!
errors.explanation: The translation misrenders 'Put out into deep water' as '你们把水倒在深水里' (you pour water into deep water), which is incorrect and nonsensical. It should convey 'push the boat out into deep water'. Also, the command to let down the nets is turned into 'put down nets to fish', which is acceptable but the first part is critically mistranslated.

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 1 西蒙回答道 : “ 大师,我们一晚上努力工作,没有抓到任何东西。 但是,因为你这么说,我就会放下网。 ”
errors.explanation: Verse numbering is wrong (repeats verse 1), but more importantly, the translation corresponds well to the source and is accurate. This is not an error; the numbering issue is formatting only.

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 当赛门·彼得看见这件事的时候,他跪在耶稣的膝上,他说:我的主啊!求你离我远点,我确是犯罪的人。
errors.explanation: The translation adds '求你离我远点' (please go away from me), which is a somewhat stronger expression than the source 'Go away from me, Lord'. The original Greek phrase is 'depart from me, Lord'. The difference is minor and the meaning is preserved.

errors.source_span: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners.
errors.translation_span: 赛门的伴侣塞贝迪的儿子詹姆士和约翰也是如此。
errors.explanation: The name 'Zebedee' is transliterated as '塞贝迪', which is an acceptable transliteration but less common; standard Chinese versions use '西庇太'. This is a minor terminology inconsistency.

errors.source_span: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣伸出手来触摸那个人,他说:我愿意。他说:你们要干净。麻风病人立刻把他带走了。
errors.explanation: The translation mistakes 'Be clean!' (singular command) as '你们要干净' (plural 'you all be clean'), which is incorrect. Also, 'And immediately the leprosy left him' is rendered as '麻风病人立刻把他带走了' (the leper immediately took him away), which reverses agent and object and changes the meaning. This is a severe mistranslation.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus ordered him, “Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
errors.translation_span: 耶 穌 就 吩咐 他 說 、 你 不 要 告 訴 人 、 你 去 向 祭 司 告 訴 、 向 他 們 獻 摩 西 所 吩 咐 的 、 使 他 們 得 完 净 的 祭 物 、 作为 他 們 的 证 据
errors.explanation: The punctuation and spacing in the Chinese translation are irregular and fragmented, which affects readability but does not change meaning.

errors.source_span: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
errors.translation_span: 但耶稣常常退避到孤单的地方祈祷 耶稣宽恕和治愈一个麻痹的人
errors.explanation: The translation includes the next verse's topic '耶稣宽恕和治愈一个麻痹的人' (Jesus forgives and heals a paralyzed man) immediately after verse 16 without separation, which could confuse the verse boundary, but does not affect the translation of verse 16 itself.

errors.source_span: Pharisees and teachers of the law
errors.translation_span: 法老和法老的老师们
errors.explanation: The translation uses '法老' (pharaoh) instead of '法利赛人' (Pharisees), which totally misrepresents the religious group mentioned.

errors.source_span: They had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem
errors.translation_span: 他们从加利利的每个村庄、朱迪亚和耶路撒冷来教书
errors.explanation: '朱迪亚' is a transliteration error (should be '犹太' Judea); '来教书' (come to teach) misrepresents 'had come' meaning the people came to be present, not to teach.

errors.source_span: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.
errors.translation_span: 一些人带着一个瘫痪的男子来到一个垫子上,试图带他进屋,躺在耶稣面前。
errors.explanation: The translation mistakenly says the paralyzed man 'came on a mat' instead of 'carried on a mat'; '来到一个垫子上' is nonsensical here.

errors.source_span: they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd
errors.translation_span: 他们爬上屋顶,将他从垫子上拖到人群中间
errors.explanation: '拖到' (dragged) is incorrect; the source describes lowering him down through the roof, not dragging him.

errors.source_span: Friend, your sins are forgiven.
errors.translation_span: 朋友啊!你们的罪过已蒙赦宥了。
errors.explanation: '你们的' (your plural) should be '你的' (your singular) to match source; '赦宥' is an uncommon word but acceptable.

errors.source_span: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law
errors.translation_span: 法老和法老的教胞们
errors.explanation: Same mistranslation of 'Pharisees' as '法老' (pharaoh); '教胞们' is awkward and incorrect for 'teachers of the law'.

errors.source_span: Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy?
errors.translation_span: 这个说亵渎话的人是谁?
errors.explanation: 'Fellow' is omitted; the wording is acceptable though more literal would be better.

errors.source_span: but God alone?
errors.translation_span: 除真主外
errors.explanation: The source says 'but God alone'; '真主' is an Islamic reference replacing 'God', which is inappropriate here and inconsistent with the Bible context.

errors.source_span: Jesus knew what they were thinking
errors.translation_span: 尔撒知道他们的想法
errors.explanation: '尔撒' is a mis-translation or transliteration for 'Jesus', causing confusion.

errors.source_span: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
errors.translation_span: 这比这更容易:你说:你们的罪行已蒙赦宥了。还是说:你们起来吧!
errors.explanation: The pronouns differ from singular to plural, slightly altering nuance; overall meaning is clear.

errors.source_span: the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins
errors.translation_span: 人子在大地上,有权赦宥罪过
errors.explanation: Acceptable translation though '大地上' (on the land) is less natural than 'on earth' as '在地上'.

errors.source_span: get up, take your mat and go home
errors.translation_span: 你们起来吧!你们把你们的床垫拿回去吧!
errors.explanation: Pronouns are plural whereas source is singular; '床垫' is not the best term for 'mat' used for lying down.

errors.source_span: he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God
errors.translation_span: 他立刻站在他们面前,拿起他所躺的东西,然后回家赞美真主
errors.explanation: '所躺的东西' is vague; '赞美真主' again uses '真主' inconsistent with Christian text.

errors.source_span: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God
errors.translation_span: 每个人都惊讶,都赞颂真主超绝万物
errors.explanation: The phrase '赞颂真主超绝万物' is an embellishment not present in source.

errors.source_span: They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”
errors.translation_span: 他们都是敬畏的,他们说:今天我们确已看见许多奇事。
errors.explanation: Translation is acceptable though '敬畏的' is more an adjective than 'filled with awe'.

errors.source_span: Jesus Calls Levi and Eats With Sinners
errors.translation_span: 耶穌喊叫里维,就召人来与罪人同吃。
errors.explanation: This phrase is out of place and merges two verses awkwardly; mistranslated and disrupts flow.

errors.source_span: Levi got up, left everything and followed him
errors.translation_span: 列维站起来,离开一切,跟着他
errors.explanation: Missing punctuation at the end; meaning is preserved but flow is incomplete.

errors.source_span: Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them
errors.translation_span: 然后利维在耶稣家举行盛宴 一大群税务员和其他人一起吃饭
errors.explanation: Missing punctuation between clauses reduces readability.

errors.source_span: the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect
errors.translation_span: 法老教徒和他们所属的教胞
errors.explanation: Again '法老' mistranslates 'Pharisees'; '教胞' is awkward; overall mistranslates source intent.

errors.source_span: complained to his disciples
errors.translation_span: 都对他的门徒说
errors.explanation: '说' (said) rather than 'complained' weakens the meaning but is minor.

errors.source_span: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
errors.translation_span: 我不是来召唤敬畏者的,而是来忏悔的。
errors.explanation: '敬畏者' (those who fear) and '忏悔的' (to repent) change the nuance; original is 'righteous' and 'to repentance' as object.

errors.source_span: John’s disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking.
errors.translation_span: 约翰的信徒们常常斋戒,他们常常祈祷,法老的信徒们也常常祈祷,但你们的信徒们却继续吃喝。
errors.explanation: '法老的信徒们' mistranslates 'Pharisees' again as '法老' (pharaoh). The phrase '你们的信徒们' is a poor translation of 'your disciples'.

errors.source_span: Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?
errors.translation_span: 你能使新郎的朋友快一点吗?
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly renders 'fast' (斋戒) as '快一点' (faster), which changes the meaning from fasting to speeding up, thus misrepresenting the original meaning.

errors.source_span: Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
errors.translation_span: 否则,新衣服将破碎,新衣服的补丁将与旧的不匹配。
errors.explanation: The phrase '新衣服将破碎' is awkward and inaccurate; '破碎' (break into pieces) does not fit well with 'new garment' being torn. A better rendering should reflect '撕烂新衣服' or '损坏新衣服'. This affects fluency but meaning is mostly clear.

errors.source_span: Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.
errors.translation_span: 否则,新酒将粉碎皮肤;葡萄酒将耗尽,葡萄酒将被毁。
errors.explanation: The phrase '新酒将粉碎皮肤' literally means 'new wine will crush the skins', which is inaccurate. It should convey that the new wine will burst or break the wineskins. Also, '葡萄酒将被毁' (wine will be ruined) mistakes the wineskins (皮囊) for wine (葡萄酒), leading to mistranslation of key terms.

errors.source_span: Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.
errors.translation_span: 缺失对应句子
errors.explanation: The entire verse where Simon answers about working all night without catching fish but agrees to lower the nets because Jesus said so is missing in the Chinese translation. This omission removes key dialogue and meaning.

errors.source_span: yours go on eating and drinking
errors.translation_span: 唯有你的门徒吃喝
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation omits the aspect of 'go on' which implies continuous action, making the statement less clear about the ongoing behavior of the disciples.

errors.source_span: One day as __PERSON_F__ was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret,[a] the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of __MOST_HIGH_A__.
errors.translation_span: 缺失对应内容
errors.explanation: 译文没有翻译这节经文的完整内容，缺少了__PERSON_F__站在革尼撒勒海边，人们围着他听话这一重要情节。

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 西门说：“师傅，我们辛苦一夜没捉到鱼。但因为你说，我就下网。”（出现在第1节重复）
errors.explanation: 原文此句位于第五节，译文将此句错误置于第一节并重复出现，且第五节在译文缺失。

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at __PERSON_F__ knees and said, “Go away from me, __MASTER_A__; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 西门彼得看到这，跪 __PERSON_F__ 跪下说：“离开我，__MASTER_A__，我是罪人！”
errors.explanation: 译文中“跪 __PERSON_F__ 跪下”语序不通顺，应调整为“他跪在__PERSON_F__膝前说”。

errors.source_span: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
errors.translation_span: 传开后，更多人来听他，说病得医治。
errors.explanation: 译文中“说病得医治”表达不够准确，原文意为“被治愈”，译文容易造成理解为“谈论被治愈”，应改为“被医治”或“得医治”。

errors.source_span: and pray
errors.translation_span: 常禁食祷告
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation includes '禁食祷告' (fast and pray), accurately reflecting the source; no omission here.

errors.source_span: but yours go on eating and drinking
errors.translation_span: 唯独你们吃喝
errors.explanation: The addition of '唯独' (only) slightly intensifies the meaning but preserves the source intent; acceptable paraphrase.

errors.source_span: Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?
errors.translation_span: 新郎在，朋友怎能禁食？
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'of the bridegroom' explicit mention but uses '朋友' (friends) which corresponds; meaning preserved and clear.

errors.source_span: No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one.
errors.translation_span: 没人拿新衣补旧衣
errors.explanation: The translation is grammatically correct and clear; no errors found.

errors.source_span: Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
errors.translation_span: 否则新衣破，补片不配旧衣
errors.explanation: The phrase '补片不配旧衣' conveys 'the patch does not match old clothes' adequately; acceptable rendition.

errors.source_span: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins.
errors.translation_span: 没人把新酒倒旧皮袋
errors.explanation: Correct and idiomatic translation.

errors.source_span: Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.
errors.translation_span: 料新酒爆袋，酒流出皮袋坏
errors.explanation: The translation communicates the consequence clearly; no critical omissions.

errors.source_span: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.
errors.translation_span: 新酒必须倒新皮袋
errors.explanation: Accurate and fluent translation.

errors.source_span: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’
errors.translation_span: 喝过旧酒没人想喝新酒，说‘旧酒好’
errors.explanation: Faithful and clear translation.

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 缺失相应译文（缺少西门回答的话）
errors.explanation: The translation skips Simon's response in verse 5 entirely, omitting the meaning that they had worked hard all night without catching anything but complied because Jesus said so.

errors.source_span: he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”
errors.translation_span: 把船划到深水处，下网捕鱼
errors.explanation: The translation uses '把船划到深水处' which is acceptable, but '划' usually means 'row', contextually it is acceptable though not inaccurate.

errors.source_span: as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God
errors.translation_span: missing
errors.explanation: The translation does not mention Jesus standing by the Lake of Gennesaret nor the people crowding around listening to the word of God.

errors.source_span: two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets
errors.translation_span: 他看见两艘船在水边,渔夫们正在洗网
errors.explanation: The source indicates the boats were left by fishermen who were washing their nets; the translation is slightly ambiguous whether the fishermen are currently washing the nets or had left the boats while washing nets.

errors.source_span: asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat
errors.translation_span: 要他从岸上放些东西。 然后坐下来,从船上教训人
errors.explanation: The phrase 'put out a little from shore' is mistranslated as 'put out some things from shore', which changes the meaning. The instruction is to move the boat a little away from the shore.

errors.source_span: Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch
errors.translation_span: 把网子放进深水中、要捕鱼
errors.explanation: The translation misses the command to put out into deep water (i.e., move the boat deeper), only mentions putting down nets into deep water, which distorts the original instruction.

errors.source_span: Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets
errors.translation_span: 西蒙回答说,“师父,我们整夜都努力工作,没钓到任何东西,但因为您这么说,我就放下网子。”
errors.explanation: This verse is duplicated in the translation as verse 1 and verse 5; the source numbering is off in the translation, which may confuse the readers.

errors.source_span: Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!
errors.translation_span: 主阿、离开我、我是罪人
errors.explanation: The translation lacks the polite interjection 'Lord' before 'go away', making the phrase somewhat less formal and potentially altering tone slightly.

errors.source_span: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken
errors.translation_span: 他和他的 companions、惊奇他们所捕的鱼
errors.explanation: The word 'companions' is untranslated (in English) in the text, which disrupts fluency and is inconsistent with surrounding Chinese translation.

errors.source_span: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners
errors.translation_span: 西门的同伙子、西伯底的儿子雅各和约翰、也一样
errors.explanation: The term 'partners' is translated as '同伙子' which may carry a slightly negative connotation rather than 'partners' or 'companions', possibly affecting nuance.

errors.source_span: a man came along who was covered with leprosy
errors.translation_span: 有一个被麻疹覆盖的人走过来
errors.explanation: The translation uses '麻疹' (measles) instead of '麻风病' (leprosy), which is a significant mistranslation changing the disease mentioned.

errors.source_span: they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus
errors.translation_span: 就上屋、把耶稣放在床上、从瓦板上往众人中间、就在耶稣面前
errors.explanation: The translation reverses the roles, wrongly stating they put Jesus on the mat and lowered him, instead of lowering the paralyzed man on his mat through the roof tiles.

errors.source_span: Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?
errors.translation_span: 这亵渎者是谁? 除了 神以外谁能赦免罪呢
errors.explanation: The translation changes 'who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy?' into 'who is this blasphemer?', which is a stronger accusation not explicitly in the source.

errors.source_span: home praising God
errors.translation_span: 回家,赞美上帝
errors.explanation: The source uses 'God' but the translation uses '上帝' instead of the consistent term '耶和华' used before, which may affect consistency in divine naming.

errors.source_span: Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?
errors.translation_span: 你能和新郎的朋友们一起吃 fast 吗 ?
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly renders 'fast' as '吃 fast' (eat fast) instead of '禁食' (fasting), reversing the meaning.

errors.source_span: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.
errors.translation_span: 惟有那日、新郎必被他们夺去、在那日必吃 fast。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'will fast' is mistranslated as '必吃 fast' (will eat fast), which is incorrect and changes the meaning entirely.

errors.source_span: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret,[a] the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.
errors.translation_span: 缺失相关内容
errors.explanation: 译文开头没有描述耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边及众人围绕听神的话的情景，遗漏了关键信息。

errors.source_span: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
errors.translation_span: 他看见两艘船站在岸边,渔夫已经从里面下来,正在洗网.
errors.explanation: 译文重复了“船站在岸边”与渔夫“从里面下来”，与原文“渔夫留下船”意思有差异，且原文强调船是渔民留下的，译文表达不够准确。

errors.source_span: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣上了其中一艘船,就是西门的,就请他从岸上稍微推开.就坐下,从船里教训众人.
errors.explanation: “从岸上稍微推开”表达不够自然，原文意为“稍微离开岸边”，译文可更流畅。

errors.source_span: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”
errors.translation_span: 他说完了,就对西门说: 赶船往深处去,把网子放下去,捕鱼.
errors.explanation: “赶船往深处去”中“赶船”不如“把船划到”或“把船开到”准确，更符合语境。

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 西门说:"主啊,我们整夜都扎,没什么抓,但因为你说的话,我要把网下去".
errors.explanation: 译文缺少西门称呼耶稣“主人”的正式表达，且“整夜都扎”用词不准确，原文为‘整夜劳累努力捕鱼’，译文表达不够准确。

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 西门彼得看见这事,就跪在耶稣面前,说:"主啊,离开我吧!因为我是个罪人.
errors.explanation: 译文漏译了“Lord”（主），以及“Go away from me”（离开我吧）具有祈使语气，中文表达不够恰当。另外，遗漏了感叹号后的情感色彩。

errors.source_span: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
errors.translation_span: 因为他和他同伴们都惊,因为他们所捕的鱼.
errors.explanation: 译文逻辑不清，缺少“惊讶”的完整表达，且“因为”重复用词，未完整表达原文意思。

errors.source_span: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners.
errors.translation_span: 西百代的儿子雅各和约翰,他们也是西门的同事.
errors.explanation: “西百代”应为“西庇太”或“西庇太的儿子”更符合圣经人名；“同事”不准确，应为“伙伴”或“同工”。

errors.source_span: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy.[b] When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣在一个城里的时候,有一个人,身体满了.看见耶稣,就俯伏地求他说:"主啊,如果你愿意,你就可以叫我洁净了".
errors.explanation: 译文“身体满了”省略了“麻风病”的信息，导致疾病描述不准确，多个重要内容缺失。

errors.source_span: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣伸出手摸他,说:"我愿意,你洁净吧!"他就马上就脱了大.
errors.explanation: “他就马上就脱了大”中文语法错误，且“脱了大”无意义，遗漏了“麻风病离开了他”的核心信息。

errors.source_span: Then Jesus ordered him, “Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
errors.translation_span: 耶稣吩咐他说: 不要告诉任何人.你要去向祭司看自己,为你的洁净献上摩西所吩咐的,为证据给他们.
errors.explanation: “去向祭司看自己”表达不准确，应为“去给祭司查看自己”或“去祭司那里展示自己”，译文不够流畅准确。

errors.source_span: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
errors.translation_span: 然而,耶稣的名声越来越传,许多人聚集来听他的话,要从他们的疾病中得救.
errors.explanation: 译文“名声越来越传”表达生硬，且“得救”偏重灵性救赎，原文为“得医治”，语义偏差。

errors.source_span: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣常往旷野去祷告,赦免子,治好子.
errors.explanation: “赦免子,治好子”无实际意义，疑为译文残留或错误添加内容，与原文不符，构成严重语法及信息错误。

errors.source_span: a paralyzed man on a mat
errors.translation_span: 一个子在床上
errors.explanation: The translation mistranslates or omits clear mention that the man is paralyzed; the phrase '一个子在床上' is unclear and does not explicitly convey that the man is paralyzed lying on a mat.

errors.source_span: they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd
errors.translation_span: 他们上了屋顶,在子里把他带着床子下去
errors.explanation: The phrase '在子里把他带着床子下去' is awkward and confusing in Chinese, making the meaning hard to recover. It seems to incorrectly translate 'through the tiles' and is grammatically flawed.

errors.source_span: new wine will burst the skins
errors.translation_span: 新酒就会破裂子
errors.explanation: The phrase '破裂子' is ungrammatical and unclear; '破裂' (burst) should not be combined directly with '子' (skins) like this. It disrupts fluency and clarity.

errors.source_span: the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined
errors.translation_span: 酒就流出,子也会丢失
errors.explanation: The word '丢失' means 'lost', which is inaccurate here; the original means the skins will be ruined/damaged, not lost.

errors.source_span: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret,[a] the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.
errors.translation_span: 西门回答说: "师父啊,我们一夜都劳碌,却没有鱼;但是因你的话,我将网子投下.
errors.explanation: The translation starts directly with Simon's reply in verse 5, completely omitting the entire content of verse 1 about Jesus standing by the Lake of Gennesaret and the crowd listening to him.

errors.source_span: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
errors.translation_span: 他看见两艘船在水边,渔民离开了,正在洗网.
errors.explanation: This translation reverses the order of the fishermen and the boats, and awkwardly states '渔民离开了' (the fishermen left), which is misleading compared to the source that the fishermen left the boats at the water's edge and were washing nets nearby. The source implication that fishermen were actively washing nets by the boats is diminished.

errors.source_span: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”
errors.translation_span: 讲完话,耶稣对西门说: "把子到深海,把网子投下去,捕鱼.
errors.explanation: The phrase '把子到深海' is unclear and should be '把船划到深水处' or similar. The original command is to put out a little from shore into deep water, but the translation is awkward and partially unclear.

errors.source_span: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”
errors.translation_span: 西门回答说: "师父啊,我们一夜都劳碌,却没有鱼;但是因你的话,我将网子投下.
errors.explanation: The translation places this verse as 5:1 but repeats it incorrectly as a starting point. Also, the original dialogue is separated awkwardly causing confusion; this is disorganized and the verse referencing is incorrect, disrupting coherence.

errors.source_span: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”
errors.translation_span: 西门彼得看见这事,就跪在耶稣面前说:主阿,离开我,因为我是罪人.
errors.explanation: Translation omits '手' or '膝盖' specifically and '离开我' is somewhat stronger than '退开我' or '离开我吧', losing a bit of original respect tone. The phrase '离开我' is harsher than the original 'Go away from me, Lord,' which is more a plea than a command.

errors.source_span: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
errors.translation_span: 因为他和他的同伴们都因他们捕鱼的惊,
errors.explanation: The translation is incomplete and fragmented. It misses the core meaning that all were astonished at the catch. The phrase ends abruptly after '惊', which is incomplete and unclear.

errors.source_span: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners.
errors.translation_span: 撒伯底的儿子雅各和约翰,西门的同事也这样.
errors.explanation: The name '撒伯底' is a mistransliteration of 'Zebedee' (应为 '西庇太'). Also, '同事' (colleagues) is less accurate than '同伴' (partners) in this fishing context.

errors.source_span: a man came along who was covered with leprosy.[b]
errors.translation_span: 有一个满满的男人来到那里.
errors.explanation: Translation uses '满满的男人' ('a full full man') which is a nonsensical phrase, failing to translate the critical meaning 'a man with leprosy'. This severely distorts the meaning.

errors.source_span: And immediately the leprosy left him.
errors.translation_span: 马上,他就从病中消失了.
errors.explanation: The phrase '从病中消失了' literally means 'disappeared from illness' which is awkward and less precise than '麻风病立刻离开了他' indicating the disease left him.

errors.source_span: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
errors.translation_span: 然而,他的名声越来越传出去,众人都来听他,被治愈他们的病.
errors.explanation: The phrase '被治愈他们的病' is ungrammatical in Chinese and awkward; better phrasing would be '来听他，得医治他们的病' or similar.

errors.source_span: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
errors.translation_span: 耶稣却往往往旷野去祷告.他赦免了一个的,治好了一个的人.
errors.explanation: The first sentence is mostly correct though '往往往旷野去祷告' contains a duplicated character '往往' (repetitive). The second part '他赦免了一个的,治好了一个的人' is unrelated to verse 16 and is both inaccurate and confusing, appearing as a fragment about forgiving and healing a man which belongs elsewhere.

errors.source_span: a paralyzed man on a mat
errors.translation_span: 一个子在床上
errors.explanation: The translation says 'a child on a bed' instead of 'a paralyzed man on a mat', which changes the meaning significantly.

errors.source_span: they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd
errors.translation_span: 就上屋顶,把他倒在床上,把他倒在人中间
errors.explanation: The phrase '倒在床上' and '倒在人中间' is awkward and unclear. It should use a verb meaning 'lowered him down' rather than '倒', which can mean 'fall' or 'pour'.

errors.source_span: So he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”
errors.translation_span: 他对子说:我告诉你,起来,拿你的,回家吧.
errors.explanation: The pronoun in '他对子说' is unclear and ambiguous; it likely aims to say 'he said to him' but is missing '他说' or similar; also missing 'mat' after 'take your' making the sentence incomplete.

errors.source_span: took what he had been lying on
errors.translation_span: 拿起床上躺的
errors.explanation: Translation omits the explicit mention of the mat on which he was lying, making the action less clear.

errors.source_span: the friends of the bridegroom
errors.translation_span: 新郎的朋友
errors.explanation: The translation uses '新郎' (bridegroom) but the English source literally says 'the friends of the bridegroom.' The source phrase 'the friends of the bridegroom' is translated as '新郎的朋友' which preserves the original meaning accurately.

errors.source_span: No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one
errors.translation_span: 没有人撕裂新衣服的块,将旧衣服起来
errors.explanation: The sentence '没有人撕裂新衣服的块,将旧衣服起来' is ungrammatical and confusing in Chinese. The English original is 'No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one.' The proper translation should reflect the idea of taking a piece from the new garment to patch the old one, but the Chinese phrase '将旧衣服起来' is unclear and incorrect grammar.

errors.source_span: Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old
errors.translation_span: 新衣服就撕裂了,新衣服的也不和旧衣服一样
errors.explanation: The Chinese translation reverses the logical cause and effect and is unclear. The English says the patch will not match the old garment, but the translation says '新衣服的也不和旧衣服一样' ('the new garment is also not like the old garment'), which is awkward and misleading. The implication that the new garment will be torn is given, but the mismatch in patching is not clearly and accurately rendered.

errors.source_span: old wineskins
errors.translation_span: 旧的子
errors.explanation: The word '子' is an uncommon and unclear abbreviation for 'wineskins' in Chinese. A more standard term would be '皮袋' or '酒袋'.

errors.source_span: the new wine will burst the skins
errors.translation_span: 新酒会撕裂子
errors.explanation: The verb '撕裂' ('tear') is inappropriate for bursting wineskins; better verbs would be '裂开' or '炸破' to indicate bursting.

errors.source_span: spent the night praying to __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.translation_span: 花费 这 夜晚 __REQUEST_A__ 到 __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.explanation: The translation uses a placeholder __REQUEST_A__ instead of a verb meaning 'praying', leading to omission of the core meaning 'prayed' or 'spent the night praying'.

errors.source_span: what they might do to __PERSON_F__
errors.translation_span: 什么 他们 可能 做 到 __人_f__
errors.explanation: The pronoun for __PERSON_F__ is inconsistent and mistranslated as __人_f__, which is incorrect and may confuse the referent.

errors.source_span: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases
errors.translation_span: WHO 有 来 到 听到 他 和 到 是 痊愈了 的 他们的 疾病
errors.explanation: Unnatural and incorrect syntax; ‘WHO’ and word order disrupt Chinese fluency and clarity.

errors.source_span: Those troubled by impure spirits were cured
errors.translation_span: 那些 陷入困境的 经过 不纯的 烈酒 是 治愈了
errors.explanation: ‘impure spirits’ mistranslated as ‘不纯的烈酒’ (impure strong liquor), which changes meaning completely.

errors.source_span: the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 这 人们 全部 尝试过 到 触碰 他， 因为 力量 曾是 未来 从 他 和 康复 他们 全部
errors.explanation: Unnatural phrasing, incorrect particle use, and malformed grammar make meaning difficult to recover.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of __MOST_HIGH_A__
errors.translation_span: 有福了 是 你 WHO 是 贫穷，为了 你的 是 这 王国 的 __最_高_a__
errors.explanation: Incorrect word order and usage of ‘WHO’; phrase is awkward and unclear.

errors.source_span: because of the Son of Man
errors.translation_span: 因为 的 这 儿子 的 男人
errors.explanation: Literal word-by-word translation results in unnatural phrase ‘这 儿子 的 男人’ instead of proper '人子' or equivalent.

errors.source_span: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy
errors.translation_span: 麾 在 那 天 和 飞跃 为了 喜悦
errors.explanation: ‘麾’ meaning ‘command’ or ‘wave’ is an incorrect translation for ‘rejoice’; awkward phrasing.

errors.source_span: Woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort
errors.translation_span: 祸患 到 你 WHO 是 富有, 为了 你 有 已经 已收到 你的 舒适
errors.explanation: ‘祸患 到 你 WHO 是 富有’ is ungrammatical and awkward Chinese; word order and choice problems.

errors.source_span: Woe to you who are well fed now
errors.translation_span: 祸患 到 你 WHO 是 出色地 美联储 现在
errors.explanation: ‘出色地 美联储’ (excellent Federal Reserve) is a severe mistranslation of ‘well fed’; phrase is nonsensical.

errors.source_span: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you
errors.translation_span: 祸患 到 你 什么时候 每个人 说话 出色地 的 你
errors.explanation: Word order and grammar are unnatural; ‘说话 出色地’ is an awkward and unclear translation of ‘speaks well’.

errors.source_span: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also
errors.translation_span: 如果 某人 打耳光 你 在 一 脸颊， 转动 到 他们 这 其他 还
errors.explanation: ‘转动’ means ‘turn around’ rather than ‘turn the other cheek’; phrase is unnatural and confusing.

errors.source_span: If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them
errors.translation_span: 如果 某人 需要 你的 外套， 做 不是 扣压 你的 衬衫 从 他们
errors.explanation: ‘需要’ means ‘need’ rather than ‘takes’; ‘做 不是 扣压’ is awkward and incorrect for ‘do not withhold’.

errors.source_span: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back
errors.translation_span: 给 到 每个人 WHO 问 你， 和 如果 任何人 需要 什么 属于 到 你， 做 不是 要求 它 后退
errors.explanation: ‘需要’ wrongly replaces ‘takes’; ‘做 不是 要求 它 后退’ is an unnatural literal translation.

errors.source_span: Do to others as you would have them do to you
errors.translation_span: 做 到 其他的 作为 你 会 有 他们 做 到 你
errors.explanation: Word order and structure produce confusing and unclear sentence.

errors.source_span: Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the __HONORED_A__, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked
errors.translation_span: 然后 你的 报酬 将要 是 伟大的， 和 你 将要 是 孩子们 的 这 __HONORED_A__, 因为 他 是 种类 到 这 忘恩负义 和 邪恶
errors.explanation: ‘是 种类 到’ is a meaningless phrase created by literal word-by-word translation instead of a natural expression; overall phrase is awkward.

errors.source_span: Do not judge, and you will not be judged
errors.translation_span: 做 不是 法官， 和 你 将要 不是 是 判断
errors.explanation: The source says 'Do not judge,' but the translation says 'do not do judge,' and then 'you will not be judged' is rendered as 'you will not do judgement,' which is inaccurate and confusing.

errors.source_span: A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap
errors.translation_span: 一个 好的 措施， 按下 向下， 动摇 一起 和 跑步 超过， 将要 是 倒 进入 你的 一圈
errors.explanation: The translation is a literal word-by-word translation with awkward word order and unnatural phrasing that impairs comprehensibility.

errors.source_span: Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?
errors.translation_span: 能 这 瞎的 带领 这 瞎的？ 将要 他们 不是 两个都 落下 进入 一个 坑？
errors.explanation: The phrase 'both fall into a pit' is mistranslated as 'both not fall into a pit,' reversing the meaning.

errors.source_span: everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher
errors.translation_span: 每个人 WHO 是 完全 训练有素的 将要 是 喜欢 他们的 老师
errors.explanation: The translation uses '喜欢' ('like/enjoy') instead of the correct meaning 'will be like' (similar to), which changes the meaning.

errors.source_span: Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?
errors.translation_span: 为什么 做 你 看 在 这 斑点 的 锯末 在 你的 兄弟 眼睛 和 支付 不 注意力 到 这 板 在 你的 自己的 眼睛？
errors.explanation: The phrase 'pay no attention' is incorrectly rendered as '支付 不 注意力' (pay no attention), which is unnatural and confusing.

errors.source_span: People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers
errors.translation_span: 人们 做 不是 挑选 无花果 从 荆棘丛, 或者 葡萄 从 荆棘
errors.explanation: The phrase 'thornbushes' is translated twice differently ('荆棘丛' and '荆棘'), which lacks consistency.

errors.source_span: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart
errors.translation_span: 一个 好的 男人 带来 好的 事物 出去 的 这 好的 已存储 向上 在 他的 心， 和 一个 邪恶的 男人 带来 邪恶的 事物 出去 的 这 邪恶的 已存储 向上 在 他的 心
errors.explanation: The phrase 'stored up in his heart' should be translated more naturally; '已存储 向上 在 他的 心' is a literal and awkward translation.

errors.source_span: Why do you call me, ‘__MASTER_A__, __MASTER_A__,’ and do not do what I say?
errors.translation_span: 为什么 做 你 称呼 我， ‘__MASTER_A__, __MASTER_A__,’ 和 做 不是 做 什么 我 说？
errors.explanation: The use of placeholders '__MASTER_A__' is consistent with instructions, but the phrase 'do not do what I say' is literally translated as '做 不是 做 什么 我 说,' which is awkward.

errors.source_span: everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice
errors.translation_span: 每个人 WHO 来了 到 我 和 听到 我的 字 和 看跌期权 他们 进入 实践
errors.explanation: 'puts them into practice' is translated as '看跌期权 他们 进入 实践' ('put options they into practice'), which is a mistranslation caused by word-by-word rendering of the verb and noun incorrectly.

errors.source_span: The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete
errors.translation_span: 这 片刻 这 激流 击中 那 房子， 它 崩溃了 和 它是 破坏 曾是 完全的
errors.explanation: The translation '它是 破坏 曾是 完全的' is an unnatural and confusing formulation that poorly renders 'its destruction was complete.'

errors.source_span: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
errors.translation_span: 在另一个安息日,他走进犹太教堂,教人教诲。有一个人的右手在那个安息日被打碎。
errors.explanation: The translation incorrectly replaces 'Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels' with 'he went into the synagogue and was teaching. There was a man whose right hand was shattered on that Sabbath.' It omits the original activity completely and wrongly shifts to a different scene.

errors.source_span: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
errors.translation_span: 法老的一些人说:你们怎么在安息日做恶事呢?
errors.explanation: 'Pharisees' is mistranslated as '法老' (Pharaoh), which is incorrect and causes misunderstanding of the antagonists in the passage.

errors.source_span: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.
errors.translation_span: 他走进真主的房屋,吃下庄稼的食品,他吃下对于祭司是合法的食物,他还以一部分供给他的同伴。
errors.explanation: The word 'house of God' is translated as '真主的房屋' which is uncommon and misleading in a Christian biblical context; '真主' is typically used in Islamic context. Also 'taking the consecrated bread' is vaguely rendered as '吃下庄稼的食品' (ate grain food), losing the specificity of consecrated bread. These lead to a major misrepresentation of the meaning.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
errors.translation_span: 尔撒对他们说:人的儿子是安息日的主。
errors.explanation: 'Jesus' is mistranslated or corrupted as '尔撒', which is a non-standard and confusing transliteration, rather than a clear known name. This impacts comprehension and clarity.

errors.source_span: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
errors.translation_span: 法利赛人和法律的老师 正在寻找一个理由 指责耶稣, 所以他们密切注视他 看他是否 将治愈安息日。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'see if he would heal on the Sabbath' is rendered as '看他是否 将治愈安息日' ('see if he would heal the Sabbath'), which is awkward and incorrect. The action 'heal on the Sabbath' is mistranslated, causing ambiguity.

errors.source_span: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Get up and stand in front of everyone.” So he got up and stood there.
errors.translation_span: 但耶穌知道他们的想法,他用的手对那个人说:你们起来,站在众人面前吧!他就站起来,站在那里。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'he said to the man with the shriveled hand' is translated awkwardly as '他用的手对那个人说' ('he used his hand to say to that man'), which is confusing and incorrect; it should be '他对那个右手枯萎的人说'. This mistranslation causes a major comprehension issue.

errors.source_span: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
errors.translation_span: 尔撒对他们说:我求你在安息日做善事,或做恶事,或拯救生命,或加以毁灭。
errors.explanation: 'I ask you' is mistranslated as '我求你' which is unidiomatic. The sentence omits the question structure that contrasts 'which is lawful' and the contrast between good/evil, save/destroy, weakening the original rhetorical question.

errors.source_span: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
errors.translation_span: 法老和法老的老师们,都发怒了,他们彼此商议他们对耶稣的所作所为。
errors.explanation: 'Pharisees' again mistranslated as '法老'. Also 'what they might do to Jesus' is vaguely translated as '他们对耶稣的所作所为' ('their actions toward Jesus'), which is less precise and does not convey discussion of schemes to act against Jesus.

errors.source_span: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:
errors.translation_span: 当早晨,他召唤他的门徒们来教化他,他从其中拣选了十二位门徒,并指定了十二位门徒。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'called his disciples to him' is mistranslated as '召唤他的门徒们来教化他' ('called his disciples to teach him'), reversing the subject-object relationship and meaning. Also, the second part repeats '拣选了十二位门徒' and '指定了十二位门徒' redundantly.

errors.source_span: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,
errors.translation_span: 西蒙(他叫彼得), 他的哥哥安德鲁, 詹姆斯,约翰, 菲利普,巴塞洛缪, 马修 托马斯 詹姆斯 阿尔法乌斯的儿子 西蒙 被称为扎洛特
errors.explanation: Missing punctuation between '巴塞洛缪' and '马修' and other names causes reduced readability. Also inconsistent spacing and missing commas affect fluency.

errors.source_span: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,
errors.translation_span: 他们是听见他的祈祷的,是因他们的病而获得治疗的。为不洁的精神而烦恼的人们,确已获得治疗了。
errors.explanation: The phrase 'come to hear him' is translated as '听见他的祈祷' ('heard his prayers'), which changes the meaning. Also, 'impure spirits' is rendered appropriately but '治愈' vs '获得治疗' can be slightly inconsistent in style.

errors.source_span: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all
errors.translation_span: 所有人都想摸他 因为力量来自他 治愈了他们
errors.explanation: Missing a comma or conjunction between phrases, making it slightly unclear; also '力量' (power) should be more closely connected to '治愈了他们' for smoothness.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God
errors.translation_span: 你们这些穷困的人,有福哉你们!因为你们的国权确是真主的
errors.explanation: '国权' (kingdom power) and '真主' (Allah) differ from 'kingdom of God' in both terminology and theological connotation; '国权' is inaccurate and '真主' implies Islamic God, which changes meaning.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh
errors.translation_span: 饥 渴 的 你 們 有 福 了 . 因 為 你 倶 必 得 满足 . 哀哭 的 你 倶 有 福 了 . 因 你 舍 必 笑
errors.explanation: The translation contains spacing errors and inconsistent characters (e.g., '倶', '你 舍') causing readability issues.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man
errors.translation_span: 当人们因为人类之子而憎恨你 排斥你 侮辱你 否认你的恶名
errors.explanation: The translation omits 'when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil' as connected clauses, rendering the meaning incomplete and the flow disjointed.

errors.source_span: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry
errors.translation_span: 哀哉你们!你们将因饥饿而得食物
errors.explanation: Translation reverses meaning: 'will go hungry' becomes 'will get food because of hunger', which contradicts the source.

errors.source_span: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets
errors.translation_span: 当众人谈论你的时候,伤哉你们!他们的祖先就是这样对待伪先知的
errors.explanation: Omission of context that people speak well of you; '谈论' (talk about) is neutral and does not convey 'speaks well of you', missing the critical negative sense.

errors.source_span: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them
errors.translation_span: 如果有人扇你一巴掌,就把另一巴掌还给他们。如果有人拿了你的外套,就不要把衬衫扣在他们身上
errors.explanation: '把另一巴掌还给他们' means 'return the other slap', which reverses the source instruction to 'turn the other cheek'; similarly '衬衫扣在他们身上' is nonsensical and inconsistent with 'do not withhold your shirt'.

errors.source_span: Do to others as you would have them do to you
errors.translation_span: 做别人,你会让他们做你
